purpose: Single-seed training/validation feasibility pilot for new endpoint-pair generalization study. Old measured models remain unchanged.

split.group: unordered pair of src_ip and dst_ip; ports excluded; both directions together

structural_audit_known_after_fixing_spli.note: These are data-support diagnostics, not prediction/accuracy metrics. Report class shift and missing attack types.

gam.type: additive cubic B-spline logistic GAM, no interactions

new_unknown_category_policy.categorical_onehot: Known categories 1..card-1 only; unseen->all-zero block. Do not add untrained random MLP weights for category0.
new_unknown_category_policy.kan: After fit, set never-trained table slot0 to0 and verify identical train logits. Document prior values. No edits to historical headers/checkpoints.

metrics.comparison_note: Seeds are optimizer repetitions, not independent captures; score differences from old split are not causal leakage estimates.

next_gate: Review feasibility, convergence warnings, artifacts and Windows replay before launching fixed five-seed study. No automatic test evaluation or firmware export.
write_scope: New runs/PAIR_STAGE1_<UTC>_<id>/ only; private source copy; no external repository edits, no serial access, no old-model loading for training.
